items.desc: description: Free 3D nuclear bomb simulator in your browser (no download): pick any city, test 8 kt–50 Mt warheads, and map blast rings, casualties & fallout live. title: Nuke Simulator — 3D Nuclear Blast Radius & Fallout Map image: https://nuclearsimulator.com/og/home.png NukeSim NukeSim Explore [Blog](/blog) 🔍 Hiroshima▾New YorkTokyoMumbaiDelhiSeoulMexico CityShanghaiDhakaLondonParisHong KongSingaporeCairoIstanbulSao PauloManilaLagosLos AngelesBeijingKarachiBuenos AiresJakartaBangkokTehranMoscowTrinity SiteHiroshimaNagasakiSemipalatinskEnewetak AtollBikini AtollNevada Test SiteNovaya ZemlyaLop NurMoruroaPokhran 📍Locate🔊English NukeSim Explore [Blog](/blog) DETONATION English✕ DETONATION Target · Global Picker📍Locate My CityNew YorkTokyoMumbaiDelhiSeoulMexico CityShanghaiDhakaLondonParisHong KongSingaporeCairoIstanbulSao PauloManilaLagosLos AngelesBeijingKarachiBuenos AiresJakartaBangkokTehranMoscowTrinity SiteHiroshimaNagasakiSemipalatinskEnewetak AtollBikini AtollNevada Test SiteNovaya ZemlyaLop NurMoruroaPokhran Go Weapon Little Boy15 kt Hiroshima, 1945 Burst Mode SurfaceAirburst CustomPRO VFXBlast statsFallout stats WIND Speed0.0 m/s Wind From82° E NESW Fallout plume enabled; after detonation drag wind speed or compass to update contours live. DETONATE Move mouse to scan · Click map, Space, or Detonate Targeted countries Little Boy15 kt Surface · Hiroshima, 1945 ▾ SurfaceAirburstCustomPRO ☀ Day Map🌙 Night Globe 💨0.0 m/s82°⚙More parametersHOB · Wind · Map▾ DETONATE ▶↺■🔊0.0s / 10.0s ORDNANCE ARCHIVE // SPECCustom Yield ├──── — ────┤ · Ø — · — Nuclear Warhead Leftdrag Orbit · Rightdrag Tilt · Scroll GlobetoStreet Zoom · Glasstone & Dolan Model Nuclear Bomb Simulator — 3D Blast Radius, Fallout & Casualty Map [Back to 3D globe](simulatorstage) About this simulator — Capabilities, Physics Model & Presets NukeSim is a free 3D nuclear bomb simulator that runs in your browser. Pick any point on the globe, choose a warhead yield and a burst height, then see the fireball, 5 psi overpressure and thermal radiation rings, estimated casualties, and the downwind fallout plume drawn on a live map — no download, no signup. What you can do Unlike a static table of blastradius numbers, every figure here is generated from the same run you are watching. You can switch between airburst and surface burst and watch the local fallout appear the moment the fireball touches the ground, drag the wind compass to push the plume over real neighbourhoods, or type a custom yield anywhere from 1 kt to 50 Mt. Twelve preset warheads are loaded — from the 8 kt W762 to the 50 Mt Tsar Bomba — alongside 25 city profiles and 11 historic test sites, each with its own density notes and benchmark results. Start with Hiroshima 1945 as a sanity check, then move to your own city. How the physics works The physics uses the Glasstone & Dolan scaling model, the same reference used by NUKEMAP, so results are comparable with published estimates. Casualty figures apply WorldPop 2020 population grids to the damage rings, which is why a 15 kt burst over central Tokyo and the same burst over a lowdensity suburb produce very different totals. This tool is for education, research and deescalation. It is not a targeting tool and contains no operational guidance. Explore the [city blast radius profiles](/cities), compare all [nuclear warhead yields and radii](/weapons), or read the [blast radius by yield chart](/blog/nuclearblastradius). smooth. GPUrendered, written in Rust, one small exe. Locus talks to MySQL / MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, Oracle and SQL Server. Results stream into the grid while the query is still running, and cancelling really stops the query on the server. Why Locus It does not freeze. Big results stream into a virtualized grid. A slow query or a huge table does not block typing, scrolling or switching tabs. It is careful with production. A connection marked Production is readonly by default. Writes need a timed unlock, every writing statement asks for its own confirmation, and each one lands in an audit log. The gate classifies the statement text; functions called by a SELECT are not checked for side effects, except known builtins (nextval, pg_terminate_backend, GET_LOCK ...). It stays out of your way. Compilation is the engine beneath scraping, discovery, crawling, and batch processing—one deterministic semantic foundation from a single URL to an entire domain. [Install](install) · [Examples](examples) · [How accurate it is](/riffkit/riffsheet/blob/main/EVAL.md) · [Limits](whatitcannotdo) · [简体中文](/riffkit/riffsheet/blob/main/README.zhCN.md) Free, MIT, runs offline with Python and ffmpeg. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other agents that can run commands and read images. Made by [Riffkit](https://riffkit.ai/?utm%5Fsource=riffsheet&utm%5Fmedium=github&utm%5Fcampaign=riffsheet&utm%5Fcontent=readme%5Fmaker). riffsheet needs no account and sends nothing to us. A video of ours, broken down by riffsheet. Full result in [examples/redcarpet](/riffkit/riffsheet/blob/main/examples/redcarpet). Install You need ffmpeg 7 or newer and Python 3.9 or newer. Spoken words need a speech recognizer: the tool's own is the optional fasterwhisper package and its speech model. When your agent judges that a video's speech matters and the recognizer is not set up, it tells you what it would add and what it costs (download, disk space, time, network), and sets it up only if you say yes (see [Requirements](requirements)). 1\. Tell your agent (Claude Code, Codex, or any agent that runs commands): Install the riffsheet skill from https://github.com/riffkit/riffsheet, then break down ~/Downloads/clip.mp4 2\. Or put it in your agent's skills folder with git: git clone https://github.com/riffkit/riffsheet ~/.claude/skills/riffsheet Claude Code git clone https://github.com/riffkit/riffsheet ~/.agents/skills/riffsheet Codex In Claude Code you can also add it as a plugin: claude plugin marketplace add riffkit/riffsheet, then claude plugin install riffsheet@riffsheet.
